SHELL_SIDE_ARM.name: Shell Side Arm
SHELL_SIDE_ARM.effect: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This move has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

SHELL_SMASH.name: Shell Smash
SHELL_SMASH.effect: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

SHIFT_GEAR.name: Shift Gear
SHIFT_GEAR.effect: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

SHOCK_WAVE.name: Shock Wave
SHOCK_WAVE.effect: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

SHORE_UP.name: Shore Up
SHORE_UP.effect: The user restores ½ of its max HP by kicking up a cloud of sand from its surroundings. In a sandstorm, the user restores ⅔ of its max HP instead.

SIGNAL_BEAM.name: Signal Beam
SIGNAL_BEAM.effect: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This move has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

SILK_TRAP.name: Silk Trap
SILK_TRAP.effect: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SILVER_WIND.name: Silver Wind
SILVER_WIND.effect: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. This also has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

SING.name: Sing
SING.effect: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

SIZZLY_SLIDE.name: Sizzly Slide
SIZZLY_SLIDE.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also burns the target.

SKITTER_SMACK.name: Skitter Smack
SKITTER_SMACK.effect: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

SKULL_BASH.name: Skull Bash
SKULL_BASH.effect: The user tucks in its head to boost its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

SKY_ATTACK.name: Sky Attack
SKY_ATTACK.effect: The user attacks with a powered-up dive the turn after using this move. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage, and it has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

SKY_DROP.name: Sky Drop
SKY_DROP.effect: The user takes the target into the sky on the first turn, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

SKY_UPPERCUT.name: Sky Uppercut
SKY_UPPERCUT.effect: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
SLACK_OFF.effect: The user slacks off, restoring ½ of its max HP.

SLAM.name: Slam
SLAM.effect: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

SLASH.name: Slash
SLASH.effect: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SLEEP_POWDER.name: Sleep Powder
SLEEP_POWDER.effect: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

SLUDGE_BOMB.name: Sludge Bomb
SLUDGE_BOMB.effect: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

SLUDGE_WAVE.name: Sludge Wave
SLUDGE_WAVE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This move has a 10% chance of poisoning targets.

SMACK_DOWN.name: Smack Down
SMACK_DOWN.effect: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. This move can hit opposing Pokémon that are in the air, including those using Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop, knocking them down to the ground.

SMART_STRIKE.name: Smart Strike
SMART_STRIKE.effect: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

SMOG.name: Smog
SMOG.effect: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This move has a 40% chance of poisoning the target.

SMOKESCREEN.name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.effect: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

SNARL.name: Snarl
SNARL.effect: The user snarls incessantly at targets, lowering the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

SNIPE_SHOT.name: Snipe Shot
SNIPE_SHOT.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s moves and Abilities that draw in moves. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SNOWSCAPE.name: Snowscape
SNOWSCAPE.effect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

SOFT_BOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFT_BOILED.effect: The user produces itself a large egg, restoring ½ of its max HP.

SOLAR_BEAM.name: Solar Beam
SOLAR_BEAM.effect: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn. In harsh sunlight, the user can attack immediately. This move’s power is halved in any other weather condition.

SOLAR_BLADE.name: Solar Blade
SOLAR_BLADE.effect: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light’s energy and attacks on the next turn. In harsh sunlight, the user can attack immediately. This move’s power is halved in any other weather condition.

SONIC_BOOM.name: Sonic Boom
SONIC_BOOM.effect: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

SPACIAL_REND.name: Spacial Rend
SPACIAL_REND.effect: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SPARK.name: Spark
SPARK.effect: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

SPARKLING_ARIA.name: Sparkling Aria
SPARKLING_ARIA.effect: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.

SPARKLY_SWIRL.name: Sparkly Swirl
SPARKLY_SWIRL.effect: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also cures the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

SPECTRAL_THIEF.name: Spectral Thief
SPECTRAL_THIEF.effect: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

SPICY_EXTRACT.name: Spicy Extract
SPICY_EXTRACT.effect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target’s Attack stat and harshly lowering the target’s Defense stat.

SPIKE_CANNON.name: Spike Cannon
SPIKE_CANNON.effect: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit 2-5 times in a row.

SPIKY_SHIELD.name: Spiky Shield
SPIKY_SHIELD.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SPIN_OUT.name: Spin Out
SPIN_OUT.effect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user’s Speed stat.

SPIRIT_BREAK.name: Spirit Break
SPIRIT_BREAK.effect: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

SPIRIT_SHACKLE.name: Spirit Shackle
SPIRIT_SHACKLE.effect: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing or switching out of battle.

SPLISHY_SPLASH.name: Splishy Splash
SPLISHY_SPLASH.effect: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.

SPORE.name: Spore
SPORE.effect: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

SPRINGTIDE_STORM.name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDE_STORM.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the Attack stats of opposing Pokémon.

STEAMROLLER.name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.effect: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

STEAM_ERUPTION.name: Steam Eruption
STEAM_ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks by immersing targets in superheated steam. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

STEEL_BEAM.name: Steel Beam
STEEL_BEAM.effect: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. After attacking, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

STEEL_WING.name: Steel Wing
STEEL_WING.effect: The target is hit with wings of steel. This move has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Defense stat.

STOMP.name: Stomp
STOMP.effect: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

STOMPING_TANTRUM.name: Stomping Tantrum
STOMPING_TANTRUM.effect: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user couldn’t act, or its move missed or failed on the previous turn.

STONE_AXE.name: Stone Axe
STONE_AXE.effect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target, damaging opposing Pokémon that switch into battle equal to ⅛ of their max HP. The stone splinters’ damage will differ depending on the Pokémon’s type matchup with the Rock type.

STONE_EDGE.name: Stone Edge
STONE_EDGE.effect: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

STORED_POWER.name: Stored Power
STORED_POWER.effect: The user attacks the target with stored power. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

STORM_THROW.name: Storm Throw
STORM_THROW.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.effect: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

STRENGTH_SAP.name: Strength Sap
STRENGTH_SAP.effect: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target’s Attack stat. It then lowers the target’s Attack stat.

STRING_SHOT.name: String Shot
STRING_SHOT.effect: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stat.

STRUGGLE.name: Struggle
STRUGGLE.effect: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no remaining PP. The user loses ¼ of its max HP.

STRUGGLE_BUG.name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLE_BUG.effect: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

STUFF_CHEEKS.name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFF_CHEEKS.effect: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

STUN_SPORE.name: Stun Spore
STUN_SPORE.effect: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

SUBMISSION.name: Submission
SUBMISSION.effect: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

SUCKER_PUNCH.name: Sucker Punch
SUCKER_PUNCH.effect: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

SUNNY_DAY.name: Sunny Day
SUNNY_DAY.effect: The user intensifies the sun for 5 turns, powering up Fire-type moves by 50%. The sunlight also halves the damage dealt by Water-type moves.

SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.name: Sunsteel Strike
SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.effect: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can ignore a target’s ability (with certain exceptions).

SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELL_SLAM.effect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. The user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP if this move misses or fails. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

SUPERPOWER.name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.effect: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

SUPERSONIC.name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.effect: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
SUPER_FANG.effect: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

SURF.name: Surf
SURF.effect: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.effect: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target’s Attack stat.

SWEET_KISS.name: Sweet Kiss
SWEET_KISS.effect: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEET_SCENT.effect: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.

SWIFT.name: Swift
SWIFT.effect: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

SWORDS_DANCE.name: Swords Dance
SWORDS_DANCE.effect: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user’s Attack stat.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.effect: The user produces energy through photosynthesis, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

TACHYON_CUTTER.name: Tachyon Cutter
TACHYON_CUTTER.effect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

TACKLE.name: Tackle
TACKLE.effect: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

TAILWIND.name: Tailwind
TAILWIND.effect: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stats of itself and its allies for 4 turns.

TAIL_SLAP.name: Tail Slap
TAIL_SLAP.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

TAIL_WHIP.name: Tail Whip
TAIL_WHIP.effect: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

TAKE_DOWN.name: Take Down
TAKE_DOWN.effect: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

TAKE_HEART.name: Take Heart
TAKE_HEART.effect: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

TEARFUL_LOOK.name: Tearful Look
TEARFUL_LOOK.effect: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETER_DANCE.effect: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

TEMPER_FLARE.name: Temper Flare
TEMPER_FLARE.effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous move failed.

TERA_BLAST.name: Tera Blast
TERA_BLAST.effect: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

TERA_STARSTORM.name: Tera Starstorm
TERA_STARSTORM.effect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user when Terastallized.

TERRAIN_PULSE.name: Terrain Pulse
TERRAIN_PULSE.effect: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.effect: The user attacks and tries to steal from the target simultaneously. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

THOUSAND_ARROWS.name: Thousand Arrows
THOUSAND_ARROWS.effect: The user attacks by generating countless arrows from its internal energy and raining them down upon targets. This move can hit opposing Pokémon that are in the air, including those using Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop, knocking them down to the ground.

THRASH.name: Thrash
THRASH.effect: The user rampages and attacks for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

THROAT_CHOP.name: Throat Chop
THROAT_CHOP.effect: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for 2 turns.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.effect: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target, and never misses in rain. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

THUNDERBOLT.name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.effect: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.effect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

THUNDEROUS_KICK.name: Thunderous Kick
THUNDEROUS_KICK.effect: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

THUNDER_FANG.name: Thunder Fang
THUNDER_FANG.effect: The user bites with electrified fangs. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

THUNDER_PUNCH.name: Thunder Punch
THUNDER_PUNCH.effect: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

THUNDER_SHOCK.name: Thunder Shock
THUNDER_SHOCK.effect: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This move has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

THUNDER_WAVE.name: Thunder Wave
THUNDER_WAVE.effect: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
TICKLE.effect: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

TIDY_UP.name: Tidy Up
TIDY_UP.effect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

TORCH_SONG.name: Torch Song
TORCH_SONG.effect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.effect: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. The target takes increasing poison damage at the end of every turn, starting at ¹⁄₁₆ of the Pokémon’s max HP, then ²⁄₁₆ and so on. If the user is a Poison-type, this move will never miss.

TRAILBLAZE.name: Trailblaze
TRAILBLAZE.effect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user’s nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.effect: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set. It also copies all of the target’s stats apart from its HP. Copied moves have 5 PP each.

TRIPLE_AXEL.name: Triple Axel
TRIPLE_AXEL.effect: A consecutive three-kick attack that increases in power by 20 with each successive hit. When one kick misses, the move ends.

TRIPLE_DIVE.name: Triple Dive
TRIPLE_DIVE.effect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water 3 times in a row.

TRI_ATTACK.name: Tri Attack
TRI_ATTACK.effect: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This move has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned, frozen, or paralyzed.

TRUMP_CARD.name: Trump Card
TRUMP_CARD.effect: This move’s power starts at 40 and increases as its remaining PP decreases: 50 at 4 PP, 60 at 3 PP, 80 at 2 PP, and 200 at 1 PP. This move never misses.

TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.effect: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. Each hit has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

TWIN_BEAM.name: Twin Beam
TWIN_BEAM.effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

TWISTER.name: Twister
TWISTER.effect: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This move has a 20% chance of making the targets flinch, and can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop with its power doubled.

UPPER_HAND.name: Upper Hand
UPPER_HAND.effect: The user reacts to the target’s movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.effect: The user attacks in an uproar for 3 turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

U_TURN.name: U-turn
U_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

VACUUM_WAVE.name: Vacuum Wave
VACUUM_WAVE.effect: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

VENOM_DRENCH.name: Venom Drench
VENOM_DRENCH.effect: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.effect: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

VINE_WHIP.name: Vine Whip
VINE_WHIP.effect: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

VISE_GRIP.name: Vise Grip
VISE_GRIP.effect: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

VITAL_THROW.name: Vital Throw
VITAL_THROW.effect: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

VOLT_SWITCH.name: Volt Switch
VOLT_SWITCH.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

VOLT_TACKLE.name: Volt Tackle
VOLT_TACKLE.effect: The user electrifies itself and charges the target to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move. This also has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

V_CREATE.name: V-create
V_CREATE.effect: The user emits a hot flame from its forehead and hurls itself at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

WAKE_UP_SLAP.name: Wake-Up Slap
WAKE_UP_SLAP.effect: This move’s power is doubled on a sleeping target. This also wakes the target up, however.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.effect: The user attacks by charging at the target with incredible momentum. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

WATER_GUN.name: Water Gun
WATER_GUN.effect: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

WATER_PLEDGE.name: Water Pledge
WATER_PLEDGE.effect: A column of water hits the target. When used alongside Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast swamp, respectively, for 4 turns.

WATER_PULSE.name: Water Pulse
WATER_PULSE.effect: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

WATER_SHURIKEN.name: Water Shuriken
WATER_SHURIKEN.effect: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first. When used by Ash-Greninja, this move’s power is increased to 20 and will always strike 3 times in a row.

WATER_SPOUT.name: Water Spout
WATER_SPOUT.effect: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

WAVE_CRASH.name: Wave Crash
WAVE_CRASH.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

WEATHER_BALL.name: Weather Ball
WEATHER_BALL.effect: This move’s type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.effect: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.

WILDBOLT_STORM.name: Wildbolt Storm
WILDBOLT_STORM.effect: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This move has a 20% chance of paralyzing targets, and never misses in rain.

WILD_CHARGE.name: Wild Charge
WILD_CHARGE.effect: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
WILL_O_WISP.effect: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

WING_ATTACK.name: Wing Attack
WING_ATTACK.effect: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

WITHDRAW.name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.effect: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
WOOD_HAMMER.effect: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

WORK_UP.name: Work Up
WORK_UP.effect: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

WRAP.name: Wrap
WRAP.effect: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

WRING_OUT.name: Wring Out
WRING_OUT.effect: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 120).

X_SCISSOR.name: X-Scissor
X_SCISSOR.effect: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

ZAP_CANNON.name: Zap Cannon
ZAP_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

ZEN_HEADBUTT.name: Zen Headbutt
ZEN_HEADBUTT.effect: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

ZING_ZAP.name: Zing Zap
ZING_ZAP.effect: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

ZIPPY_ZAP.name: Zippy Zap
ZIPPY_ZAP.effect: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.

OVERGROW.name: Overgrow
OVERGROW.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Grass-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to ⅓ or less of its max.

CHLOROPHYLL.name: Chlorophyll
CHLOROPHYLL.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

THICK_FAT.name: Thick Fat
THICK_FAT.description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

BLAZE.name: Blaze
BLAZE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to ⅓ or less of its max.

SOLAR_POWER.name: Solar Power
SOLAR_POWER.description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% but it loses ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

TOUGH_CLAWS.name: Tough Claws
TOUGH_CLAWS.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s contact moves by 30%.

DROUGHT.name: Drought
DROUGHT.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

TORRENT.name: Torrent
TORRENT.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Water-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to ⅓ or less of its max.

RAIN_DISH.name: Rain Dish
RAIN_DISH.description: The Pokémon has ¹⁄₁₆ of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain.

MEGA_LAUNCHER.name: Mega Launcher
MEGA_LAUNCHER.description: Boosts the power of Aura Sphere and moves with "Pulse" in their names by 50%.

SHIELD_DUST.name: Shield Dust
SHIELD_DUST.description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

RUN_AWAY.name: Run Away
RUN_AWAY.description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

SHED_SKIN.name: Shed Skin
SHED_SKIN.description: The Pokémon has a 30% chance to cure its own status conditions at the end of every turn by shedding its skin.

COMPOUND_EYES.name: Compound Eyes
COMPOUND_EYES.description: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy by 30%.

TINTED_LENS.name: Tinted Lens
TINTED_LENS.description: The Pokémon’s "not very effective" attacks deal double damage.

SWARM.name: Swarm
SWARM.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Bug-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to ⅓ or less of its max.

SNIPER.name: Sniper
SNIPER.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.

ADAPTABILITY.name: Adaptability
ADAPTABILITY.description: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Pokémon by 100% instead of 50%. Does not stack with the Stellar-type Tera boost.

KEEN_EYE.name: Keen Eye
KEEN_EYE.description: The Pokémon’s keen eyes ignore changes to targets’ evasiveness and prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

TANGLED_FEET.name: Tangled Feet
TANGLED_FEET.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s evasiveness if it is confused.

BIG_PECKS.name: Big Pecks
BIG_PECKS.description: The Pokémon’s Defense stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

NO_GUARD.name: No Guard
NO_GUARD.description: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land. If this Pokémon is your lead into battle, it raises the likelihood of double battles.

STATIC.name: Static
STATIC.description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and has a 30% chance to paralyze attackers that hit it with a contact move.

LIGHTNING_ROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNING_ROD.description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

ELECTRIC_SURGE.name: Electric Surge
ELECTRIC_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

FLASH_FIRE.name: Flash Fire
FLASH_FIRE.description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves by 50%.

STENCH.name: Stench
STENCH.description: By releasing a stench when attacking, there is a 10% chance that targets damaged by the Pokémon’s moves will flinch. This does not stack with moves or items that have a chance to flinch.

EFFECT_SPORE.name: Effect Spore
EFFECT_SPORE.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.

PICKUP.name: Pickup
PICKUP.description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle, even if it did not participate.

TECHNICIAN.name: Technician
TECHNICIAN.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s moves by 50% if their power is 60 or less.

UNNERVE.name: Unnerve
UNNERVE.description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

LIMBER.name: Limber
LIMBER.description: The Pokémon’s limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

INTIMIDATE.name: Intimidate
INTIMIDATE.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

JUSTIFIED.name: Justified
JUSTIFIED.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

SYNCHRONIZE.name: Synchronize
SYNCHRONIZE.description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Pokémon’s move or Ability, that Pokémon will also be inflicted with the same status condition. If this Pokémon is your lead into battle, opposing wild Pokémon will share its nature.

INNER_FOCUS.name: Inner Focus
INNER_FOCUS.description: The Pokémon’s intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

MAGIC_GUARD.name: Magic Guard
MAGIC_GUARD.description: The Pokémon takes damage only from attacks.

TRACE.name: Trace
TRACE.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it changes its Ability to match that of an opponent.

GUTS.name: Guts
GUTS.description: The Pokémon is so gutsy that when it has a status condition, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%. Being burned does not halve the damage dealt by the Pokémon’s physical moves.

STEADFAST.name: Steadfast
STEADFAST.description: The Pokémon’s determination boosts its Speed stat when it flinches.

ROCK_HEAD.name: Rock Head
ROCK_HEAD.description: The Pokémon will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.

STURDY.name: Sturdy
STURDY.description: If the Pokémon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokémon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

SAND_VEIL.name: Sand Veil
SAND_VEIL.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

MAGNET_PULL.name: Magnet Pull
MAGNET_PULL.description: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

ANALYTIC.name: Analytic
ANALYTIC.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s move by 30% when the Pokémon is the last to move that turn.

LEVITATE.name: Levitate
LEVITATE.description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

CURSED_BODY.name: Cursed Body
CURSED_BODY.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the attacker has a 30% chance to have whichever move it last used disabled for 4 turns.

SHADOW_TAG.name: Shadow Tag
SHADOW_TAG.description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

WEAK_ARMOR.name: Weak Armor
WEAK_ARMOR.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a physical move, its Defense stat is lowered, but its Speed stat is boosted sharply.

RECKLESS.name: Reckless
RECKLESS.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s moves by 20% if they have recoil or crash damage.

NATURAL_CURE.name: Natural Cure
NATURAL_CURE.description: The Pokémon’s status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.

SERENE_GRACE.name: Serene Grace
SERENE_GRACE.description: Doubles the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves. This does not affect items.

HEALER.name: Healer
HEALER.description: The Pokémon has a 50% chance of curing the status conditions of its allies at the end of every turn.

SWIFT_SWIM.name: Swift Swim
SWIFT_SWIM.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in rain.

DAMP.name: Damp
DAMP.description: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct or dealing damage with Aftermath.

POISON_POINT.name: Poison Point
POISON_POINT.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

RATTLED.name: Rattled
RATTLED.description: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

MOXIE.name: Moxie
MOXIE.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

MOLD_BREAKER.name: Mold Breaker
MOLD_BREAKER.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

WATER_ABSORB.name: Water Absorb
WATER_ABSORB.description: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.

SHELL_ARMOR.name: Shell Armor
SHELL_ARMOR.description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

HYDRATION.name: Hydration
HYDRATION.description: Cures the Pokémon’s status conditions at the end of every turn in rain.

IMPOSTER.name: Imposter
IMPOSTER.description: The Pokémon transforms into the Pokémon in front of it. It also copies all of that Pokémon’s stats apart from its HP. Copied moves have 5 PP each.

ANTICIPATION.name: Anticipation
ANTICIPATION.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it senses whether the opponents know any one-hit KO moves or moves that are super effective against it.

VOLT_ABSORB.name: Volt Absorb
VOLT_ABSORB.description: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.

QUICK_FEET.name: Quick Feet
QUICK_FEET.description: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Pokémon’s Speed stat.

PRESSURE.name: Pressure
PRESSURE.description: Puts opposing Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend 1 more PP when using moves against it.

IMMUNITY.name: Immunity
IMMUNITY.description: The Pokémon’s immune system prevents it from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

GLUTTONY.name: Gluttony
GLUTTONY.description: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP drops to ¼ or less of its max, it will instead eat that Berry when its HP drops to ½ or less of its max.

SNOW_CLOAK.name: Snow Cloak
SNOW_CLOAK.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness by 25% in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

FLAME_BODY.name: Flame Body
FLAME_BODY.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being burned.

MARVEL_SCALE.name: Marvel Scale
MARVEL_SCALE.description: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its marvelous scales boost its Defense stat by 50%.

MULTISCALE.name: Multiscale
MULTISCALE.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

INSOMNIA.name: Insomnia
INSOMNIA.description: The Pokémon’s insomnia prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

LEAF_GUARD.name: Leaf Guard
LEAF_GUARD.description: The Pokémon is immune to status conditions in harsh sunlight.

MEGA_SOL.name: Mega Sol
MEGA_SOL.description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

SHEER_FORCE.name: Sheer Force
SHEER_FORCE.description: The Pokémon’s moves lose their additional effects, but the power of those moves will be boosted by 30%.

DRAGONIZE.name: Dragonize
DRAGONIZE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

HUSTLE.name: Hustle
HUSTLE.description: When the Pokémon uses physical moves, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%, but its accuracy is lowered by 20%.

SUPER_LUCK.name: Super Luck
SUPER_LUCK.description: The Pokémon is so lucky that its moves have their critical-hit ratio boosted by 1 stage.

PLUS.name: Plus
PLUS.description: The Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

EARLY_BIRD.name: Early Bird
EARLY_BIRD.description: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

MAGIC_BOUNCE.name: Magic Bounce
MAGIC_BOUNCE.description: Instead of being affected by other Pokémon’s status moves, the Pokémon bounces them back at the user.

PRANKSTER.name: Prankster
PRANKSTER.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s status moves by 1 stage. Dark-type Pokémon are immune to these moves.

SAND_FORCE.name: Sand Force
SAND_FORCE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

CONTRARY.name: Contrary
CONTRARY.description: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them — and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

SKILL_LINK.name: Skill Link
SKILL_LINK.description: The Pokémon’s multistrike moves always hit the max amount of times.

PICKPOCKET.name: Pickpocket
PICKPOCKET.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it will steal a held item from the attacker.

OBLIVIOUS.name: Oblivious
OBLIVIOUS.description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

STALWART.name: Stalwart
STALWART.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

SAND_STREAM.name: Sand Stream
SAND_STREAM.description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when it enters a battle.

REGENERATOR.name: Regenerator
REGENERATOR.description: The Pokémon has ⅓ of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.

UNBURDEN.name: Unburden
UNBURDEN.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat when its held item is consumed or lost.

SPEED_BOOST.name: Speed Boost
SPEED_BOOST.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat at the end of every turn.

TELEPATHY.name: Telepathy
TELEPATHY.description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

PIXILATE.name: Pixilate
PIXILATE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

INFILTRATOR.name: Infiltrator
INFILTRATOR.description: When using its moves, the Pokémon ignores the effects of targets’ Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

WONDER_GUARD.name: Wonder Guard
WONDER_GUARD.description: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

HYPER_CUTTER.name: Hyper Cutter
HYPER_CUTTER.description: The Pokémon’s prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering its Attack stat.

HUGE_POWER.name: Huge Power
HUGE_POWER.description: Doubles the power of the Pokémon’s physical moves.

FILTER.name: Filter
FILTER.description: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from supereffective moves by 25%.

MINUS.name: Minus
MINUS.description: The Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

WHITE_SMOKE.name: White Smoke
WHITE_SMOKE.description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents its stats from being lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

SUCTION_CUPS.name: Suction Cups
SUCTION_CUPS.description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

STORM_DRAIN.name: Storm Drain
STORM_DRAIN.description: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

BATTLE_ARMOR.name: Battle Armor
BATTLE_ARMOR.description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

COMPETITIVE.name: Competitive
COMPETITIVE.description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted sharply.

CUTE_CHARM.name: Cute Charm
CUTE_CHARM.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of becoming infatuated if the attacker and the Pokémon are of opposite genders.

ICE_BODY.name: Ice Body
ICE_BODY.description: The Pokémon has ¹⁄₁₆ of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

MOODY.name: Moody
MOODY.description: At the end of every turn, one of the Pokémon’s stats will be boosted sharply, but another will be lowered. Accuracy and evasiveness are excluded.

REFRIGERATE.name: Refrigerate
REFRIGERATE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

CLEAR_BODY.name: Clear Body
CLEAR_BODY.description: The Pokémon’s stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

DRIZZLE.name: Drizzle
DRIZZLE.description: The Pokémon makes it rain for 5 turns when it enters a battle.

PRIMORDIAL_SEA.name: Primordial Sea
PRIMORDIAL_SEA.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

DESOLATE_LAND.name: Desolate Land
DESOLATE_LAND.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

DELTA_STREAM.name: Delta Stream
DELTA_STREAM.description: The Pokémon changes the weather so that no moves are supereffective against the Flying type.

IRON_FIST.name: Iron Fist
IRON_FIST.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s punching moves by 20%.

RIVALRY.name: Rivalry
RIVALRY.description: The Pokémon’s competitive spirit boosts the power of its moves by 25% against targets of the same gender, and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender. The power remains the same as usual if either Pokémon’s gender is unknown.

STICKY_HOLD.name: Sticky Hold
STICKY_HOLD.description: The Pokémon’s held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be stolen or removed by other Pokémon.

KLUTZ.name: Klutz
KLUTZ.description: Items do not work when held by the Pokémon.

SCRAPPY.name: Scrappy
SCRAPPY.description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

ROUGH_SKIN.name: Rough Skin
ROUGH_SKIN.description: The Pokémon’s rough skin damages attackers that hit it with contact moves for ⅛ of their max HP.

SNOW_WARNING.name: Snow Warning
SNOW_WARNING.description: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

SOUNDPROOF.name: Soundproof
SOUNDPROOF.description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

SOLID_ROCK.name: Solid Rock
SOLID_ROCK.description: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from supereffective moves by 25%.

SHARPNESS.name: Sharpness
SHARPNESS.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s slicing moves by 50%.

MULTITYPE.name: Multitype
MULTITYPE.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate it holds.

SAND_RUSH.name: Sand Rush
SAND_RUSH.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

PIERCING_DRILL.name: Piercing Drill
PIERCING_DRILL.description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing ¼ of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

POISON_TOUCH.name: Poison Touch
POISON_TOUCH.description: When the Pokémon hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

OVERCOAT.name: Overcoat
OVERCOAT.description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms or hail, and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder or spores.

ANGER_POINT.name: Anger Point
ANGER_POINT.description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

SLUSH_RUSH.name: Slush Rush
SLUSH_RUSH.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

DEFIANT.name: Defiant
DEFIANT.description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted sharply.

SAP_SIPPER.name: Sap Sipper
SAP_SIPPER.description: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat.

TURBOBLAZE.name: Turboblaze
TURBOBLAZE.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

TERAVOLT.name: Teravolt
TERAVOLT.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

BULLETPROOF.name: Bulletproof
BULLETPROOF.description: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

MAGICIAN.name: Magician
MAGICIAN.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

PROTEAN.name: Protean
PROTEAN.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

CHEEK_POUCH.name: Cheek Pouch
CHEEK_POUCH.description: The Pokémon has ⅓ of its max HP restored when it eats a Berry, in addition to the Berry’s usual effect.

GALE_WINGS.name: Gale Wings
GALE_WINGS.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

FIRE_MANE.name: Fire Mane
FIRE_MANE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50%.

GRASS_PELT.name: Grass Pelt
GRASS_PELT.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

OWN_TEMPO.name: Own Tempo
OWN_TEMPO.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

STANCE_CHANGE.name: Stance Change
STANCE_CHANGE.description: The Pokémon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King’s Shield.

AROMA_VEIL.name: Aroma Veil
AROMA_VEIL.description: The Pokémon and its allies are protected from Infatuation, Taunt, Torment, Disable, Heal Block, and Encore.

DRY_SKIN.name: Dry Skin
DRY_SKIN.description: Restores ¼ of the Pokémon’s max HP when hit by Water-type moves or ⅛ of the its max HP at the end of every turn in rain. However, the Pokémon receives 25% more damage from Fire-type moves and loses ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn in harsh sunlight.

STRONG_JAW.name: Strong Jaw
STRONG_JAW.description: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves by 50%.

GOOEY.name: Gooey
GOOEY.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

FRISK.name: Frisk
FRISK.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s Ability.

FAIRY_AURA.name: Fairy Aura
FAIRY_AURA.description: Boosts the power of the Fairy-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

DARK_AURA.name: Dark Aura
DARK_AURA.description: Boosts the power of the Dark-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

LONG_REACH.name: Long Reach
LONG_REACH.description: None of the moves used by the Pokémon are considered contact moves.

LIQUID_VOICE.name: Liquid Voice
LIQUID_VOICE.description: The Pokémon’s sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

BATTERY.name: Battery
BATTERY.description: Powers up special moves used by allies by 30%.

VITAL_SPIRIT.name: Vital Spirit
VITAL_SPIRIT.description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

MERCILESS.name: Merciless
MERCILESS.description: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

STAMINA.name: Stamina
STAMINA.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted.

WATER_BUBBLE.name: Water Bubble
WATER_BUBBLE.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

CORROSION.name: Corrosion
CORROSION.description: The Pokémon can poison or badly poison targets even if they’re Steel or Poison types.

FLUFFY.name: Fluffy
FLUFFY.description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

DISGUISE.name: Disguise
DISGUISE.description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack at the cost of losing ⅛ of its max HP.

STEELWORKER.name: Steelworker
STEELWORKER.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Steel-type moves by 50%.

PSYCHIC_SURGE.name: Psychic Surge
PSYCHIC_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

GRASSY_SURGE.name: Grassy Surge
GRASSY_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

MISTY_SURGE.name: Misty Surge
MISTY_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

FULL_METAL_BODY.name: Full Metal Body
FULL_METAL_BODY.description: The Pokémon’s stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities. This effect cannot be ignored.

SHADOW_SHIELD.name: Shadow Shield
SHADOW_SHIELD.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

LIBERO.name: Libero
LIBERO.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

MIRROR_ARMOR.name: Mirror Armor
MIRROR_ARMOR.description: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Pokémon bounces them back at whichever Pokémon caused them.

PUNK_ROCK.name: Punk Rock
PUNK_ROCK.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s sound-based moves by 30%. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves

SCREEN_CLEANER.name: Screen Cleaner
SCREEN_CLEANER.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

ICE_SCALES.name: Ice Scales
ICE_SCALES.description: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

INTREPID_SWORD.name: Intrepid Sword
INTREPID_SWORD.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

DAUNTLESS_SHIELD.name: Dauntless Shield
DAUNTLESS_SHIELD.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

UNAWARE.name: Unaware
UNAWARE.description: The Pokémon ignores the target’s stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker’s stat changes when being attacked. It cannot ignore changes to the Speed stat, however.

PURIFYING_SALT.name: Purifying Salt
PURIFYING_SALT.description: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

SPICY_SPRAY.name: Spicy Spray
SPICY_SPRAY.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

OPPORTUNIST.name: Opportunist
OPPORTUNIST.description: When an opponent’s stats are boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost its own stats in the exact same way.

TOXIC_DEBRIS.name: Toxic Debris
TOXIC_DEBRIS.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

WATER_VEIL.name: Water Veil
WATER_VEIL.description: The Pokémon’s water veil prevents it from being burned.

SUPREME_OVERLORD.name: Supreme Overlord
SUPREME_OVERLORD.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokémon in its party that has been defeated in battle already. The maximum boost is 50%

PROTOSYNTHESIS.name: Protosynthesis
PROTOSYNTHESIS.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

QUARK_DRIVE.name: Quark Drive
QUARK_DRIVE.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

THERMAL_EXCHANGE.name: Thermal Exchange
THERMAL_EXCHANGE.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

GOOD_AS_GOLD.name: Good as Gold
GOOD_AS_GOLD.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

ORICHALCUM_PULSE.name: Orichalcum Pulse
ORICHALCUM_PULSE.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.

HADRON_ENGINE.name: Hadron Engine
HADRON_ENGINE.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

targets.title: Targets & placement
targets.intro: A Pokémon attacks the same from any row. Placement decides who hits whom.
targets.rulesTitle: How an attacker picks its target

front.name: Front row first
front.desc: Attacks aim at the opponent's frontmost row (the one closest to you). When that row is knocked out, the next row becomes the front. A Pokémon taking several cells counts from its frontmost cell.

lane.name: Nearest column
lane.desc: With several Pokémon in that row, the attacker picks the one closest to it horizontally. Wide Pokémon are measured from their middle. The attacker's own row does not matter.

immune.name: Immune foes are skipped
immune.desc: Foes the move cannot touch (Normal or Fighting moves against a Ghost, {{levitate}} or {{balloon}} against Ground, absorbing abilities like {{waterAbsorb}} or {{voltAbsorb}}) are passed over, and the attacker picks the frontmost, nearest foe it can hit. If none can be hit, it attacks the front row anyway.

spread.name: Spread moves
spread.desc: Moves like {{rockSlide}} or {{heatWave}} also hit foes orthogonally touching the target. {{earthquake}} and {{surf}} also hit allies touching the user.

special.name: Exceptions
special.desc: Moves like {{outrage}} or {{thrash}} pick a random foe. Pokémon with {{infiltrator}} or {{stalwart}} aim at the foe with the lowest HP percentage.

frontOnly.name: Front-row-only effects
frontOnly.desc: {{intimidate}} only reaches the opponent's front row. A foe with {{shadowTag}} slows the gauge of your front row.

wall.name: One wall draws every hit
wall.desc: Put a single sturdy Pokémon in the front row and every enemy attack goes to it, while your attackers hit safely from behind. When the wall falls, the row behind becomes the front.

split.name: A wide front row splits damage
split.desc: With one Pokémon at each end of the front row, each foe hits the closer one, so the damage is shared and nobody gets focused down early.

focus.name: Group attackers to focus fire
focus.desc: Attackers on the same side all hit the same foe and knock it out fast. Spread them out and their damage is split across foes.

immune.name: An immune wall gets walked past
immune.desc: A Ghost in front does not shield against Normal attacks: the foe skips it and hits the Pokémon behind. Give the wall role to something the enemy's moves can hit.

spread.name: Leave a gap against spread moves
spread.desc: Touching Pokémon take a spread move together; one a cell apart is safe. You lose touching bonuses from items and abilities, so weigh it.

quake.name: Keep {{earthquake}} users apart
quake.desc: {{earthquake}} and {{surf}} also hit allies touching the user. Keep it apart, or put a Flying type or a {{levitate}} Pokémon next to it, which {{earthquake}} cannot touch.
